'''Unit Aurek-Nine''' was a four-man [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in [[Aurek Company]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Legion/Legends|Legion]], as reactivated by the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Primary Target">[[Fool's Bargain]]</ref>

Along with the rest of Aurek Company, Aurek-Nine participated in [[Capture of the Warlord|the liberation of]] [[Kariek]].<ref name="Primary Target" />
